method: KERF_STRESS=1; existing linear solid FEA, unchanged material, supports, mesh settings and acceptance limits; one rejected geometry candidate. No fatigue life measured.

retained_design.why: freestyle needs >= 6:1; catalog XING2 2207 max thrust 1685 g at full output, x 0.74^2 for the 74 % Betaflight motor_output_limit that keeps the XT60 in rating = 922.7 g x 4 motors = 3691 g
printed frame no heavier than 250 g
normal flight: steady thrust at the configured 74% motor output, catalog 1685 g x 0.74^2 x 9.81 / 1000 = 9.0517 N; a static strength/deflection screen, not a transient envelope or fatigue-life proof

retained_design.why: the arm's first up-down bending mode (motor + prop on its tip) must sit >= 20 % away from the hover rotor rate and the blade-pass rate (15-20 % separation from excitation: KnightHawk Engineering, modernpumpingtoday.com/modal-testing-of-pump-bearing-housings); a static-compliance estimate at hover, not a full operating-speed modal or fatigue-life proof; gyro filtering does not establish mechanical endurance during spool-up
